dimensions.description: Selects Carve only through exact canonical invocation and rejects ambient planning or unresolved-idea activation.

evals.name: canonical-settled-planning-request
evals.prompt:
/carve

Turn these settled migration requirements into a ready ticket DAG.
evals.expected_output: The host records Carve and its complete canonical dependency closure.
expectations: Carve activates through exact canonical invocation.

evals.name: ambient-settled-planning-request
evals.prompt: Turn these settled migration requirements into implementation tickets.
evals.expected_output: Carve stays inactive because it requires exact canonical invocation.
expectations: The host records no Carve selection or load.

evals.name: canonical-unsettled-idea-boundary
evals.prompt: I have a vague idea for improving account preferences. Break it into tickets.
evals.expected_output: Carve stays inactive because the request is neither canonical nor backed by settled requirements.
expectations: The host records no Carve selection or load.
